Connect to your Discourse forum with an:
Connect to your Discourse forum with an API key.

1. In Discourse go to **Admin → Advanced → API Keys** (`https://your-forum.example.com/admin/api/keys`) and click **New API Key**.
2. Choose **User Level: All Users** and **Scope: Global** (admin, moderation and webhook triggers need a global key created by an admin). A granular key works only for the endpoints you tick.
3. Copy the key, and enter the username the requests should act as (for example `system` or your admin username).

This trigger creates a webhook in your Discourse forum automatically when the flow is published and removes it when the flow is turned off.

It needs a **global API key created by an admin** (Admin → Advanced → API Keys). Every delivery is checked against the HMAC signature Discourse sends in X-Discourse-Event-Signature.
